records.source_paraphrase: Relative strengths of Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Mars and Mercury are used to assign one of five elements and corresponding temperaments; multiple strong planets allow a mixed assignment.
records.critical_limit: The excerpt does not fully specify how to resolve all strength ties or score mixed temperament. No dreams inferred without later slokas.

records.source_paraphrase: A predominantly windy temperament is associated with flying through the sky in dreams, alongside numerous waking physical and temperament claims.
records.critical_limit: Predominant temperament must be computed independently; self-selected type after dream report would leak outcome.

records.source_paraphrase: The bilious temperament is associated with dreams involving gold, the Sun, light, forest fire, red flowers, blood or lightning.
records.critical_limit: Multiple listed motifs are correlated and broad; need predetermined item-level frequency and explicit negative predictions.

records.source_paraphrase: The phlegmatic temperament is associated with dreams of seas, rivers, lakes, aquatic objects, swans and snow.
records.critical_limit: Opportunity-independent self-report possible, but recall and motif base rates need controls; no personally inferred temperament.

records.source_paraphrase: This verse says favorable results of a weak planet's daśā can appear in dreams and thoughts, contrasting subjective experience with external fruition.
records.critical_limit: The text does not describe particular dream contents here; identify which outcome and interval before measuring.

records.source_paraphrase: The next verse distinguishes beginning, middle and end of planetary periods according to rising type of a planet's sign.
records.critical_limit: This is an approximate phase claim, not a date or exact timing error margin.

records.source_paraphrase: Mercury in Sagittarius is associated with engaging in abstract meditation, along with education, teaching, charity and other qualities.
records.critical_limit: This broad signature is not equivalent to formal religious initiation or alleged enlightenment.

records.source_paraphrase: Mercury in Capricorn is associated among many negative traits with dreaming and wandering.
records.critical_limit: It does not say frequency/vividness or whether the dreams are extraordinary; literal dream mention alone is weakly testable.

records.source_paraphrase: A meteor, strong aerial disturbance, earthquake/thunder or specified omen at birth is claimed to cancel beneficial rulership yogas.
records.critical_limit: Cannot compute observed meteor/weather/earthquake from natal planetary positions alone; omit from chart-only scoring unless independently recorded.

records.locator: Ch2 tenth-house subsection v33, PDF59 printed56
records.source_paraphrase: The main daśā of the tenth lord combined with a malefic subperiod is linked to nightmares, mental worry, imprisonment and disrepute.
records.critical_limit: The printed page has Sanskrit+English; language/edition collation and a specific dasha algorithm remain unverified.

records.locator: Ch16 Venus trinal main period, subperiod v8, PDF368 printed365
records.source_paraphrase: Venus located in a trinal house with a malefic subperiod is associated with disturbing dreams and a fall in reputation.
records.critical_limit: The paragraph spans translator English and neighboring Sanskrit verses; printed verse grouping must be critically collated.

records.locator: Saturn subperiod adverse outcomes, cp1252 TXT line4499
records.source_paraphrase: Saturn eight or twelve houses from the dasha lord is claimed to generate bad dreams along with distress and losses.
records.critical_limit: The exact dasha and subperiod chain, special aspects and edition remain unverified.

records.locator: Gulika tenth-house effects, cp1252 TXT line2264
records.source_paraphrase: Gulika in the tenth house is said to indicate meditation and religious practice as well as worship, family happiness and comforts.
records.critical_limit: Gulika's calculation and sunrise method are school-dependent; not a prediction of meditative attainment.

records.locator: Avasthas de Mercúrio, cp1252 TXT line3612
records.source_paraphrase: Mercury in Sabha avastha while exalted is among other effects said to bring complete enlightenment, in a passage that also mentions wealth, rulership and Vishnu/Shiva devotion.
records.critical_limit: No externally verifiable claim about an individual's enlightenment; avastha computation and textual legitimacy need validation.

records.locator: Adhyaya V-A sloka11, PDF714 printed916 (volume II)
records.source_paraphrase: Stronger of Sun/Moon plus decanate lord is used to assign a supposed prior-birth realm (divine, ancestral, human, infernal) with gradation by planetary dignity.
records.critical_limit: Not an observable historical birth record; cannot score as independently known in present natal questionnaire.

records.locator: Adhyaya V-A sloka15, PDF715-716 printed917-918 (volume II)
records.source_paraphrase: The chapter assigns supposed postmortem realms through designated decanate lords and describes Jupiter/Pisces configurations as granting emancipation; Sastri's separate PDF716 note explicitly distinguishes moksha from heavenly realms.
records.critical_limit: Original verse vs modern translator note must not be merged. The claims are neither prospective nor independently verifiable for a living participant.
